modelName: LLM in the National Spatial Data Infrastructure
aiTask: Semantic search in natural language and natural language geodata querying
inputSpecification:
Natural language user queries. 
PoC 1 uses metadata from the geocat.ch API. 
PoC 2 uses geodata from the geoadmin.ch API
outputSpecification:
PoC 1 returns relevant datasets, metadata summaries and geodata previews where available. 
PoC 2 displays relevant geodata on a map and supports limited data analysis, such as filtering
primaryPerformanceMetric: No quantitative primary performance metric available. The prototypes have been tested by external parties. It is difficult to make a definitive assessment: on the one hand, the potential of conversational interfaces to lower the barrier for non expert users is highlighted; on the other hand, there are issues of trust and performance that need to be addressed.
license: Not publicly reusable. Internal code only.
moreInformation:
Published documentation: https://www.geoinformation.ch/de/projektseite-llm
Internal final report available on request.
